Definition: from G2380 (in the sense of blowing) a storm:--tempest.
BiblicalUsage: thýella is the word for a tempest, a storm. In Hebrews 12:18, darkness, and tempest.
TheologicalSignificance: Darkness and tempest at the mountain make me grateful I come to God through Jesus now, not through fire I cannot approach.
